metadata.question: Was the Antarctic ozone hole larger on October 7, 2021 than compared to its area on January 1, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use OMI (Ozone Monitoring Instrument) data from Sentinel-5P, which provides total ozone column measurements. - Collection: `COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3` - Dates: January 1, 2021 and October 7, 2021 - Location: Antarctic region (roughly -90 to -60 latitude, -180 to 180 longitude) - The ozone hole is typically defined as regions with total ozone column < 220 DU (Dobson Units). 2. **Masking strategy**: - Filter by quality assurance flags to remove poor-quality pixels. - Define ozone hole as pixels with O3 column < 220 DU. - Calculate the area (pixel count) of the ozone hole for each date. 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error**: - If collection is empty, return C1. - If pixel count after filtering is 0 (e.g., no pixels below 220 DU threshold), this is still valid (ozone hole area = 0), not C2. Only return C2 if valid pixels for measurement are 0 due to masking/QA. - If O3 values are None, NaN, or out of physical range (e.g., negative or > 500 DU), return C3. - Compare the two areas: if October 7, 2021 area > January 1, 2021 area → Answer A (Yes), else → Answer B (No). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Antarctic region (south of 60°S) const antarcticRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -60]); // Load Sentinel-5P Ozone data const o3Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') .filterBounds(antarcticRegion); // January 1, 2021 const jan1_2021 = o3Collection .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-01-02') .first(); // October 7, 2021 const oct7_2021 = o3Collection .filterDate('2021-10-07', '2021-10-08') .first(); // Check if images exist const jan1_exists = jan1_2021.bandNames().size().getInfo() > 0; const oct7_exists = oct7_2021.bandNames().size().getInfo() > 0; if (!jan1_exists || !oct7_exists) { print("Missing data for one or both dates."); print("C1"); return; } // Extract O3 column band (in DU) const jan1_o3 = jan1_2021.select('O3_column_number_density'); const oct7_o3 = oct7_2021.select('O3_column_number_density'); // Validate data values const jan1_mean = jan1_o3.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: antarcticRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); const oct7_mean = oct7_o3.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: antarcticRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); if (jan1_mean === null || oct7_mean === null || isNaN(jan1_mean) || isNaN(oct7_mean)) { print("Invalid O3 values detected."); print("C3"); return; } // Define ozone hole as O3 column < 220 DU const ozoneHoleThreshold = 220; // Calculate ozone hole area (count pixels < 220 DU) const jan1_hole = jan1_o3.lt(ozoneHoleThreshold); const oct7_hole = oct7_o3.lt(ozoneHoleThreshold); const jan1_count = jan1_hole.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: antarcticRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); const oct7_count = oct7_hole.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: antarcticRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Calculate ozone hole pixel area (number of pixels with O3 < 220 DU) const jan1_holeArea = jan1_hole.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarcticRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); const oct7_holeArea = oct7_hole.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarcticRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Validate results if (jan1_holeArea === null || oct7_holeArea === null) { print("Ozone hole area calculation failed."); print("C3"); return; } print("Jan 1, 2021 - O3 Mean: " + (jan1_mean / 46.698).toFixed(1) + " DU, Hole Pixels: " + jan1_holeArea); print("Oct 7, 2021 - O3 Mean: " + (oct7_mean / 46.698).toFixed(1) + " DU, Hole Pixels: " + oct7_holeArea); // Compare ozone hole areas if (oct7_holeArea > jan1_holeArea) { print("Oct 7, 2021 ozone hole was larger than Jan 1, 2021."); print("A"); } else { print("Oct 7, 2021 ozone hole was not larger than Jan 1, 2021."); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
